project_type: Vite-powered static site with Three.js 3D globe and GSAP scroll animations, deployed to GitHub Pages
build_system: Vite 8.x with npm scripts. Multi-page app via rollupOptions.input collecting species/*.html pages. Base path is /species-on-screen/
test_framework: None - no test runner configured. Validation is build-only.
test_command: npm run build (no tests exist, build success is the validation)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to confirm Vite produces dist/ without errors. 2. Check that dist/index.html and dist/species/ directories exist. 3. Optionally run npm run preview to manually inspect.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/data/*.json files are generated by scripts/fetch-tmdb-data.js from TMDB API. They are checked into the repo.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22 available. No Docker daemon needed. TMDB API key provided in the request.
contribution_requirements: Branch feat/cinematic-rebuild created from feat/multi-species-tmdb. Deploy workflow triggers on main branch push.
key_patterns: - Single index.html entry with JS modules in src/ - Per-species HTML pages in species/ that load species-page.js and fetch JSON from public/data/ - Globe uses procedural canvas texture with OrbitControls - GSAP ScrollTrigger for scroll-linked animations - CSS uses custom properties, glass-panel aesthetic - fetch-tmdb-data.js hardcodes all species data and queries TMDB without filtering, resulting in contaminated results
directory_structure: / - root with index.html, vite.config.js, package.json; src/ - JS modules and CSS; species/ - per-species HTML pages; public/data/ - generated JSON data per species; scripts/ - TMDB data fetch pipeline; .github/workflows/ - deploy.yml for Pages
